package invalid

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func invalidPredicateSource(objects project.Objects) {
	var predicate orm.Predicate[authors.Author] = objects.BlogPost.Reviewer.IsNull(true)
	_ = predicate
}
